newsitem.title: USA: LaserMaster files for secondary offering.
newsitem.headline: LaserMaster files for secondary offering.

text.p: LaserMaster Technologies Inc filed a registration statement for a secondary offering of up to 518,530 common shares which a trade creditor, Marubeni International Electronics Corp, may sell in the future.

The filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission was made in connection with an agreement in September in which Marbeni would convert $2.5 million in trade debt into a subordinated debenture convertible into common stock.

Under the agreement, the conversion would be made gradually and Marubeni, which is part of Japan's Marubeni Corp, will continue to supply products to LaserMaster under favorable credit and payment terms.
LaserMaster spokesman Michael Dreis said the registration rights carry "significant restrictions" on the number of shares Marubeni may sell over time.
